body.message:
Thank you for confirming. I will proceed with the check-out.

However, before I leave, please confirm in writing that the refund for one full night has been approved and will be processed. I am leaving because of the bed bug infestation and the serious health and safety issues it has caused for my children.

Please also confirm that there will be no additional charges or penalties for checking out early due to this issue.

Thank you.
